title: Partite matching factorial bound
statement: Let $r$ and $k$ be natural numbers with $r>0$. The number of partite perfect matching codes with parameters $2r$ and $k$, regarded as a real number, is at most $\left(\frac{2r-1}{r}\right)^{rk}((rk)!)^2$.
